title: How to keep your Gmail Account Secure?
title_hi: अपने जीमेल अकाउंट को सुरक्षित कैसे रखें?
content:
Like every other email servers, Google’s systems are also prone to cyber attack. To neutralize
these actions, one has to stay updated with the security features and suggestions provided by
Gmail.
Among the few easiest steps in this regard, the preliminary one is not to disclose your login
credentials. Any emails or text inquiring such details should be ignored immediately. Any email
servers including Gmail would never request such information explicitly form users. Further one
should be in practice of changing passwords frequently. Gmail too recommends changing your
password twice a year at least without repeating the previous passwords in the span of six
months.
content_hi:
हर दूसरे ईमेल सर्वर की तरह, Google & rsquo; सिस्टम भी साइबर हमले के लिए प्रवण हैं।
को बेअसर करने के लिए इन कार्रवाइयों में, किसी को
द्वारा प्रदान की गई सुरक्षा सुविधाओं और सुझावों के साथ अद्यतन रहना होगा जीमेल।
इस संबंध में कुछ सबसे आसान कदमों में से प्रारंभिक एक आपके लॉगिन का खुलासा नहीं करना है
साख। ऐसे विवरण पूछने वाले किसी भी ईमेल या पाठ को तुरंत अनदेखा किया जाना चाहिए। कोई ईमेल
जीमेल समेत सर्वर कभी भी ऐसी जानकारी का अनुरोध नहीं करेंगे जो स्पष्ट रूप से उपयोगकर्ताओं को बनाये। आगे एक
अक्सर पासवर्ड बदलने के अभ्यास में होना चाहिए। जीमेल भी आपके
को बदलने की सिफारिश करता है छह साल के दौरान पिछले पासवर्ड दोहराए बिना कम से कम दो बार पासवर्ड दो बार
महीने।

ai_summary: Never disclose your login credentials; Gmail will never request them via email or text.
Change your password at least twice a year and avoid reusing passwords across different sites.
Always use HTTPS for secure connections and log out from public computers to protect your account.

sub_contents.sub_content:
Password security also demands non repetitive usage of the same password on multiple websites. For instance, using same password on Gmail along with some other website increases the chance of its discovery. It is for the reason, that the other website may not follow the high security measures as advance email servers do and password once revealed from that system may also be used by the hacker for login trials on your Gmail web account.


Strong email password should be created using letters and the numbers both. After creating the password one should neither make a note of it nor should it be mailed to self. Actually, this turns out a very common mistake. If it is difficult to remember, put down a clue for yourself which should not hold any segment of the password.
Keeping your system (PC) secure is incredibly crucial. Updates are persistently released by the vendors of operating systems and web browsers for keeping them secure. Running some antivirus software ensures the security of your system software even if your email server is under some security threat.


Make sure you update your Gmail account instantly if you make any change in your secondary Email address or in your security question. Accuracy of this information will ensure easiness in recovering your web account.


As the previously used protocol “HTTP” was less secure, one should always choose the option of using “HTTPS” connection while setting up the Gmail account. This prevents the hijacking of personal information while accessing from public computers. Also, while using a public network or computer, like in cyber café, one must ensure that he has completely logged out the account before leaving.
If at any instant you notice any unidentified changes or requests in your account, right away modify the entire log in credentials being used at that time. Recurrent scans should be run. There are various free of cost malware detection and anti-spyware software available over the internet. Using such software will make it easier for you to discover any threat over your system.
sub_contents.sub_content_hi:
पासवर्ड सुरक्षा कई वेबसाइटों पर एक ही पासवर्ड के दोहराव के उपयोग की भी मांग करती है। उदाहरण के लिए, किसी अन्य वेबसाइट के साथ जीमेल पर एक ही पासवर्ड का उपयोग करके इसकी खोज का मौका बढ़ जाता है। यही कारण है कि दूसरी वेबसाइट उच्च सुरक्षा उपायों का पालन नहीं कर सकती है क्योंकि अग्रिम ईमेल सर्वर करते हैं और उस प्रणाली से एक बार पासवर्ड खोले जाने पर आपके जीमेल वेब खाते पर लॉगिन परीक्षणों के लिए हैकर द्वारा भी इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है। <पी>
मजबूत ईमेल पासवर्ड दोनों अक्षरों और संख्याओं का उपयोग करके बनाया जाना चाहिए। पासवर्ड बनाने के बाद किसी को न तो इसका नोट बनाना चाहिए और न ही इसे स्वयं को मेल किया जाना चाहिए। असल में, यह एक बहुत ही आम गलती है। यदि याद रखना मुश्किल है, तो अपने लिए एक सुराग डालें जो पासवर्ड के किसी सेगमेंट को नहीं रखे।
अपने सिस्टम (पीसी) को सुरक्षित रखना अविश्वसनीय रूप से महत्वपूर्ण है। अपडेट को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम और वेब ब्राउज़र के विक्रेताओं द्वारा अद्यतन लगातार जारी किए जाते हैं। कुछ एंटीवायरस सॉफ़्टवेयर चलाना आपके सिस्टम सॉफ़्टवेयर की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करता है भले ही आपका ईमेल सर्वर कुछ सुरक्षा खतरे में है। <पी>
सुनिश्चित करें कि आप अपने जीमेल खाते को तत्काल अपडेट करते हैं यदि आप अपने द्वितीयक ईमेल पते में या अपने सुरक्षा प्रश्न में कोई बदलाव करते हैं। इस जानकारी की शुद्धता आपके वेब खाते को पुनर्प्राप्त करने में आसानी सुनिश्चित करेगी। <पी>
पहले इस्तेमाल प्रोटोकॉल के रूप में & ldquo; HTTP & rdquo; कम सुरक्षित था, किसी को हमेशा & ldquo; HTTPS & rdquo का उपयोग करने का विकल्प चुनना चाहिए; जीमेल खाता सेट करते समय कनेक्शन। यह सार्वजनिक कंप्यूटर से एक्सेस करते समय व्यक्तिगत जानकारी को अपहरण से रोकता है। साथ ही, सार्वजनिक नेटवर्क या कंप्यूटर का उपयोग करते समय, साइबर कैफ और ईक्यूट में, किसी को यह सुनिश्चित करना होगा कि उसने छोड़ने से पहले खाते को पूरी तरह से लॉग आउट कर दिया हो।
यदि किसी भी समय आप किसी भी अज्ञात परिवर्तन या अपने खाते में अनुरोधों को देखते हैं, तो उस समय उपयोग किए जा रहे प्रमाण-पत्रों में पूरे लॉग को तुरंत संशोधित करें। आवर्ती स्कैन चलाया जाना चाहिए। इंटरनेट पर उपलब्ध विभिन्न निःशुल्क मैलवेयर पहचान और एंटी-स्पाइवेयर सॉफ़्टवेयर उपलब्ध हैं। ऐसे सॉफ़्टवेयर का उपयोग करने से आपके सिस्टम पर कोई खतरा खोजना आसान हो जाएगा।
& Nbsp;

related.title: Impact of Rising Fuel Prices on Indian Economy
related.title_hi: भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था पर बढ़ती ईंधन की कीमतों का प्रभाव
related.content:
Rising fuel prices have a significant impact on the Indian economy, affecting various sectors and the daily lives of citizens. As fuel prices increase, transportation costs rise, leading to higher prices for goods and services. This situation creates a ripple effect, influencing inflation rates and overall economic stability.

Moreover, higher fuel costs strain the budgets of both individuals and businesses, leading to decreased consumer spending and investment. Understanding these dynamics is crucial for grasping the broader economic implications of fuel price fluctuations in India.

related.title: Impact of Electric Vehicles on India's Economy
related.title_hi: भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था पर इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों का प्रभाव
related.content:
Electric vehicles (EVs) are rapidly transforming the transportation landscape in India, presenting both challenges and opportunities for the economy. As the country strives to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels and combat pollution, the adoption of electric vehicles is becoming a pivotal part of its economic strategy. This shift not only promises to create a greener environment but also offers significant economic benefits, from job creation to advancements in technology.

The shift towards electric mobility is expected to enhance India's energy security, create new markets, and foster innovation in various sectors. By investing in EV infrastructure and technologies, India aims to position itself as a global leader in the electric vehicle industry, contributing positively to the overall economic growth.

related.title: What is an annular solar eclipse?
related.content:
As the name suggests it is a solar eclipse. There are three major types of solar eclipses.

The total solar eclipse, partial solar eclipse, and the annular solar eclipse.  

The name “annular” has its origin from the Latin word “annulus”, "a ring". If the characteristic ring of fire is visible from even just one location, the whole eclipse is called an annular solar eclipse.

However, in most places and for most of the duration, an annular eclipse looks like a partial solar eclipse. At Box of Science, we are trying to reach out to people so that they may understand and observe this celestial event, as such events are very rare.

related.title: Fact Check: Is World Going To End On June 21 According To Mayan Calendar?
related.title_hi: तथ्य की जाँच करें: क्या मई 21 कैलेंडर के अनुसार विश्व का अंत हो सकता है?
related.content:
Fact check: A number of social media users have shared a conspiracy theory suggesting that the world will end on June 21, 2020, but they have proven false.

 

What does the theory suggest? 

According to various conspiracy theorists on social media, the initial reading of the Mayan calendar which suggested that the world will end in 2012 was wrong. It originally prophesied by calendar readers that the world will end on December 21, 2012, according to the Mayan calendar. The new theory suggests that we are 'technically' still in the year 2012 if the Julian calendar is followed. The theory also bases its claims on a previously falsified theory which suggested that eight years were lost during the transition from the Julian to the Gregorian calendar. 

 

Origin

Social media has witnessed a recent trend where a number of conspiracy theorists have been posting unverified theories on the internet which increase the paranoia in people's minds. As the COVID-19 outbreak became a global scare, a number of users started posting theories that suggest that 2020 will be the final year witnessed by humanity. Some wild theories also suggested that the events of the apocalypse are taking place in the world, but did not have any concrete evidence backing them. Similarly, the recent conspiracy theory doing the rounds on social media which suggests that the world will end on June 21, 2020, according to the Mayan calendar also does not hold any truth. 

 

The world was previously prophesied to end on December 21, 2012. Various conspiracy theorists used the Mayan calendar to push a theory that put a doomsday on Earth's experience. This latest conspiracy theory also uses the Mayan calendar theory which was officially shunned by NASA back in 2012. NASA officials had stated during a public conversation there was no science behind any claims of disaster and dramatic changes in 2012, also that there was no evidence that could back the theory. Since there was no evidence, NASA deemed the theory as a fictional assertion that could not change the facts. 

 

Google Trends Analysis

As witnessed earlier, the conspiracy theories which suggest dramatic and disastrous consequences often gain traction from people who wish to find the truth themselves. Similarly, a number of people took to Google and searched whether the recent conspiracy theory holds any truth to it. This resulted in a surge of search results surrounding topics like 'Alternate reading of Mayan calendar', 'Mayan calendar June 21, 2020', and various others.

 

source: https://www.republicworld.com/fact-check/viral/fact-check-is-the-world-going-to-end-on-june-21.html
